subject: world_language
concept: Saying 'I like' and 'I don't like' about a food or activity in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR A1 'express likes/dislikes' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts food/activity picture cards into 'I like' and 'I don't like' piles while saying the phrase aloud
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a facial expression to the correct like/dislike phrase
exercise.abstract: Student writes or says a sentence expressing like or dislike about a given item

misconception_flags: confuses the like and dislike phrase structures

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
